comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-24: on main in 2fc39ea8. A fold that cannot reach its home is recorded on the participant (folds_owed, persisted) and sent when the link returns, before the refetch. A routed join's groups list stays this machine's view, which is complete apart from a fold still owed.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: When an agent names itself while the home of a group its pane was in is unreachable, that home keeps listing the pane name, and nothing retries the swap (peer Join with was) when the link returns. Also: a join routed to another machine always reports took_over false, and its groups list is this machine's view.
title: A pane's rename never reaches a group home that was unreachable at the time
